_doc: RATIFIED DIVERGENCES + JUDGMENT-CALL CORRECTIONS. Two lists. `divergences` = places where our corpus text DELIBERATELY differs from what the source page legibly prints, each ratified. `pending_review` = corrections made on Claude's own contextual judgment (with outside knowledge, as sanctioned) and awaiting Luneth's end-of-campaign sweep. WHY IT EXISTS: on 2026-08-02 a vision sweep re-flagged WAL-CLM-LETS-000349 (toxin/antitoxin) and WAL-CLM-IMMORT-000024 (1n/1nm) as defects. BOTH had already been ruled on and corrected in earlier sessions, and neither was written down -- so each was re-derived at the cost of a render, a 20x-40x read and an adversarial second read. Luneth: 'we already fixed this ... note it this time so this doesn't need to be re-derived.'
_the_rule: The page is EVIDENCE, not ground truth. Luneth 2026-08-02: 'the books are RIDDLED with errors ... we NEED outside information to correct it -- what we DON'T correct is true Wallach statements even if his statements disagree with outside norms, what we DO fix is when there's a clear typo or error.' So a genuine Wallach claim stands even against mainstream fact; a typesetter's or scanner's error gets fixed, using outside knowledge, and gets logged HERE for his review.
_internal_only: A verification-audit artifact. Read by tooling only. MUST NOT be surfaced to the user, rendered on any app surface, or folded into a derived artifact. Nothing under eden/tools/ is consumed by corpus_derive/build_embeds/build.mjs -- verified 2026-08-02 -- and that must stay true.
_standard: Each entry states what OUR text holds, what the PAGE prints, WHO decided, WHEN, and the EVIDENCE. An entry without a decider and a reason is not a ratified divergence -- it is an undisclosed change, which is the defect class this file prevents.
